~Adaptation~.Upgrade: You can get this Feat multiple times.
~Adaptation~.Name: ~Adaptation~

~Novice Magic~.Effect: You can also pick Level 1 Talents from {Class}, instead of picking from yours.
~Novice Magic~.Upgrade: When you gain a Level 1 Talent, you can choose to skip it to instead pick one from a Level 1 {Class} Talent Set.
~Novice Magic~.Name: ~Novice Magic~

~Multiclass~.Effect:
You gain starting Abilities of the {ThisClass} Class{Other}.
When you gain a Talent (or for the ones at Level 1), you can choose to skip a Talent from your original Class to instead pick one from a {ThisClass} Talent Set of the same Level.
~Multiclass~.Upgrade: You still only gain 1 Class Talent per Level! This means, for example, that for the Level 2 Talents you can still pick only one, either from your original Class or from {ThisClass}. You do ^not^ get both!

Variants.Cost: -9 total in any Stats and -1 Health Regen
Variants.Other: . At Level 2, you can pick a Specialization and get all starting Abilities from it

Variants.Cost: -5 total in any Stats and -1 Health Regen
Variants.Other: . At Level 2, you can pick a Specialization and get all starting Abilities from it

Variants.Cost: -2 total in any Stats and -1 Health
-7 total in any Stats and -2 Health

Variants.Other: , but Better Faster Stronger only applies to Artificer Talents and you do not get the extra starting Stat

Variants.Cost: -2 total in any Stats and -2 Health
-4 total in any Stats and -2 Health

~Multiclass~.Name: ~Multiclass~

~Multirace~.Effect: Choose another Race. Get 1 Racial Talent from that Race. You can now also forego any of your own Race's Talents to instead pick from that chosen Race.
~Multirace~.Name: ~Multirace~

~Confident Attacks~.Effect: You ignore weapon stat requirements and you can replace one of the Stats from the weapon Damage or text with Focus, Presence or Presence.
~Confident Attacks~.Notes: For example, you can wield a Dagger even if your Instinct is 0, and its Damage can become 1d4 + Presence.
~Confident Attacks~.Name: ~Confident Attacks~

~Darkvision~.Effect: You have no penalty for attacking in the dark.
~Darkvision~.Name: ~Darkvision~

~Unarmed Combat~.Effect: {CriticalStrike} if you roll maximum on d6, also add your other Stat to the Damage, or Slam the target that other Stat meters in any direction.
~Unarmed Combat~.Notes:
On a Critical Strike, if you used Might, you also add Instinct to the roll (or vice-versa, if you used Instinct, you also add Might).
If you used another Stat (certain weird Abilities do this), you add either Might or Instinct, of choice.
~Unarmed Combat~.Name: ~Unarmed Combat~

~Opposite Magic~.Effect: Choose 2 non-physical Damage Types. For you, those Damage Types are swapped.
~Opposite Magic~.Upgrade: The Damage Type swap is ^mandatory^, but can be changed inbetween Adventures.
~Opposite Magic~.Name: ~Opposite Magic~
~Opposite Magic~.Notes: For example, you may choose to swap Fire with Cold. Then all baseline Fire Damage you would deal becomes Cold, and all your baseline Cold Damage becomes Fire. In all text on your Spells, those two words become interchanged.

~Manic Casting~.Effect:
Every Turn, roll 1d6.
Your first Ability this Turn may cost more or fewer {A}Action Points:
~Manic Casting~.Name: ~Manic Casting~

~Dual Wielding~.Requirement: Only applies while wielding a different weapon in each hand
~Dual Wielding~.Effect: After you make a weapon attack, you can move 1 meter.
~Dual Wielding~.Name: ~Dual Wielding~

~Old-Fashioned Armsman~.Effect: Your attacks with Weapons that originally have no Stat requirement deal +1 Damage.
~Old-Fashioned Armsman~.Name: ~Old-Fashioned Armsman~

~Double Greatwielding~.Requirement: Trained in Two-Handed melee weapons and at least 2 Might
~Double Greatwielding~.Effect:
You can dual wield Two-Handed melee weapons, one in each hand.
If you make weapon attacks like this, each attack takes only 1 {A}Action Point and does -7 Damage.
When dual wielding them, if any Ability tells you to perform an attack with a Two-Handed and the ability costs 2 {A}Action Points, it costs only 1 {A}Action Point.
~Double Greatwielding~.Notes: Alternatively, you can wield a Shield in one hand and a Two-Handed melee weapon in the other.
~Double Greatwielding~.Name: ~Double Greatwielding~

~Highlander Technique~.Requirement: Trained in One-Handed and Two-Handed melee weapons
~Highlander Technique~.Effect:
You can wield One-Handed melee weapons with both hands.
If you do, your Two-Handed weapon attacks with One-Handed melee weapons take 2 {A}Action Points and deal an extra +2d6 Damage.
~Highlander Technique~.Name: ~Highlander Technique~

~Improviser~.Effect:
When you make an Improvised Attack, if you're attacking with an object you found in that environment and the object can break, it breaks, and the Damage becomes 1d8 + Might if melee, or 1d6 + Instinct if ranged.
Additionally, you can pick up objects with 0 {A}Action Points.
~Improviser~.Notes: The object must weigh at least 500 grams.
~Improviser~.Name: ~Improviser~

~Tower Shield Training~.Requirement: Trained in Shields, at least 2 Might
~Tower Shield Training~.Effect: You can wield a Tower Shield. A Tower Shield gives you a +1 Defense bonus, but reduces your Movement Speed by 1.
~Tower Shield Training~.Notes: Check the Weapons list for the stats of a Tower Shield. Check the Shop to see the price of a Tower Shield.
~Tower Shield Training~.Name: ~Tower Shield Training~

~Shield Dual-Wielding~.Effect:
You can wield a Shield in each hand. If you do, you gain an extra +1 Defense, in addition to what the Shield normally gives.
Attacks with a normal Shield now deal 1d6 + ^Might^ Damage (and the Shield counts as a weapon you're Trained in).
~Shield Dual-Wielding~.Upgrade:
If you have Tower Shield Training, you can dual-wield Tower Shields (or a normal Shield and a Tower Shield).
Each Shield gives you its boon, aside from the +1 Defense of this Feat (e.g. Shield + Tower Shield = 50% Pierce Resistance, +1 Defense from the Tower Shield, +1 Defense from this Feat).
~Shield Dual-Wielding~.Name: ~Shield Dual-Wielding~

~Throwing Expert~.Effect: You can throw melee weapons at up to 5 meters range and with their own damage and effects. Thrown One-Handed Weapons have a -2 Penalty and Two-Handed Weapons a -4 Penalty.
~Throwing Expert~.Name: ~Throwing Expert~

~Blindness~.Effect:
You are blind in your eyes, but can understand your surroundings using your other senses.
You fail all Checks for seeing (or related).
You are immune to being Blinded and take -50% Psychic Damage.
~Blindness~.Name: ~Blindness~
~Blindness~.Notes: A Blind Unit's next Damage/Heal Act deals -50% Damage/Healing.

~Deafness~.Effect:
You are deaf in your ears, but can read lips and sense the rest of your surroundings using your other senses.
You fail all Checks for hearing (or related).
You are immune to being Silenced and take -50% Psychic Damage.
~Deafness~.Name: ~Deafness~
~Deafness~.Notes: A Silenced Unit can't use Abilities.

~Missing Arm~.Effect:
You are missing an arm or a hand, but make up in accuracy with the other one.
You can't use Two-Handed weapons and Shields.
Every turn, your first Act that deals Damage ignores Cover.
~Missing Arm~.Name: ~Missing Arm~

~Missing Leg~.Effect:
You are missing a leg or a foot, but make up in body movement.
You are immune to being Double-Stunned and take -50% Pulse Damage.
~Missing Leg~.Name: ~Missing Leg~
~Missing Leg~.Notes: A Double-Stunned Unit has -2 Action Point on its (next) Turn.

~Chronic Sickness~.Effect: You gain +1 Presence if it's below 3.
~Chronic Sickness~.Name: ~Chronic Sickness~

~Vampirism~.Effect: Your Health Regen is always 0. Whenever a Worthy Enemy dies in combat, Heal for 10% of its Max Health.
~Vampirism~.Downside: The only way to get this Feat is to have it inflicted upon you by a vampire or curse.
~Vampirism~.Upgrade: Drinking person blood every Adventure (or refusing to) might have unknown effects. The curse progresses...
~Vampirism~.Name: ~Vampirism~

~Complications~.Effect:
When you perform a surgery, gene editing, or a similar procedure, roll 1d10.
On 1, the subject gets a Negative Quirk.
On 10, the subject gets a Positive Quirk.
~Complications~.Name: ~Complications~

~Planebound~.Effect:
Your auguments and operations are instead done with {Element} magic, and the modifications are akin to {Akin}. The lower the Presence of your subjects, the more they start resembling {Resembling}.
Your summons and creations now deal {SummonDamage} instead, and your weapons and other Spells can freely change their Damage to {OtherDamage}.

Variants.Akin: druidic enhancements or replacements, such as growing tree-like tendrils instead of mechanical parts, or planting special seeds instead of implants
Variants.Resembling: a wild treant or a feral lesh of sorts

Variants.Akin: the butcherings of a surgeon or the flesh fusions of a necromantic doctor, such as adding a different, biologically modified arm instead of a mechanical one, or inserting special tumors instead of implants
Variants.Resembling: a laboratory creation from a mixture of flesh, bone, and aberrant tissue.

Variants.Akin: warped eldritch symbiotes and living darkness, such as grafting writhing shadow-tendrils that defy geometry or embedding unblinking, dark-adapted eyes across the body
Variants.Resembling: a multi-eyed, formless abomination that swallows light

Variants.Akin: bioluminescent abyssal grafts and calcified deep-sea growths, such as replacing skin with barnacle-encrusted chitin, growing barbed tentacles instead of arms or legs, or implanting unknowable growths instead of implants
Variants.Resembling: a bloated, pale trench-monstrosity or a grotesque, multi-jawed leviathan-spawn

~Planebound~.Name: ~Planebound~

~Reverse Operation~.Effect:
Perform a reverse operation to remove one of the implants, replaced limbs, or another augmentation.
The subject gets -1 Health permanently, but the augment and its effects are undone.
~Reverse Operation~.Upgrade: The subject might then be affected with a respective Affliction Feat without paying the cost in Stats (e.g. no "-1 Movement" penalty for now missing a leg).
~Reverse Operation~.Name: ~Reverse Operation~

~Order of the Left Hand~.Effect:
Your Abilities' {Teal(After)} effects don't trigger if the previous Act was of that type.
Instead, they trigger when you do the {Teal(Next)} Act if it's of that type.
~Order of the Left Hand~.Notes: You can replace the word {Teal(After)} with {Teal(Next)} in other contexts.
~Order of the Left Hand~.Name: ~Order of the Left Hand~

~Overload Magic~.Effect:
You can go up to -2 in debt with your {Mana}Mana.
You start next Adventure with less {Mana}Mana, to repay your debt.
~Overload Magic~.Downside: Requires a Campaign of multiple Adventures.
~Overload Magic~.Name: ~Overload Magic~

<Battle Enmity>.Effect:
While not in combat, Awe does +100% Healing.
Awe can no longer trigger while in Combat.
<Battle Enmity>.Name: <Battle Enmity>

~Renounce~.Effect: You renounce your companion, and effectively disable them. Your Max Health increases by 4 and any Soulwright Cleric boons and Talents your companion had (or would have in the future) are transferred to you.
~Renounce~.Name: ~Renounce~

~Wildcasting Form~.Effect:
When you Shapeshift, transform into a combination of 3 ^random^ animal features instead of choosing, ignoring the Level requirements.
Roll 3d12 and reroll any duplicates to determine your form.
~Wildcasting Form~.Name: ~Wildcasting Form~

<Lycanthropy>.Effect:
Once per _twilight_ (18:00 to 6:00), you can use Shapeshift to transform into a Lycanthrope until the end of your next turn (see the Lycanthrope form under Pets and Animals).
While a Lycanthrope, you can't willingly shift to another form, and you must Animal Attack with all of your Actions, otherwise you take 5 Damage for each 1 {A}Action Point spent elsehow.
<Lycanthropy>.Upgrade:
Every Worthy _midnight_, if this is not on Cooldown, roll 1d20. If you roll 20, you automatically transform into a Lycanthrope. This rule can be overridden by the QM.Notes: While a Lycanthrope, you have 8 meters Movement Speed, one extra 1 {A}Action Point per turn (including this), can Break your Movement and Pet Attack heals you for half of the Damage done.
Additionally, you have a base speed of 8 meters, and can use Ominous Howl, which Fears all Units that can hear you for a 1 {A}Action Point, once per Adventure.
<Lycanthropy>.Name: <Lycanthropy>

<Traditionalist>.Effect:
Gain a Level 3 Draven Talent and Parry from the Level 3 Watcher Talents.
You no longer Know any Basic Abilities.
<Traditionalist>.Name: <Traditionalist>

<Lich Ritual>.Requirement: Cleric, Mage or Warlock and Level 5
<Lich Ritual>.Effect:
You spend 24 hours in a special place of power (this could be a temple or given to you by your QM).
After it's finished, you become a Lich, and you are considered Undead.
Apply the following:
{Diamond} You can no longer cast Basic Abilities that don't cost {Mana}Mana, but gain 2 extra Max {Mana}Mana (or 1 if you're a Warlock). Passive Spells that don't cost {Mana}Mana still apply.
{Diamond} You are Undead, thus immune to Fear and being put to Sleep
{Diamond} You no longer need to eat, drink or sleep.
{Diamond} You gain access to the Elemental and Eldritch Basic Ability Lists if you don't have them already
You also gain the Phylactery, Dismorphment and Death Pact Abilities.
<Lich Ritual>.Upgrade:
At Level 6, the range of all your Spells is doubled.
At Level 7, your Initiative increases by 1.
At Level 8, all your Checks increase by 1.
At Level 9, your Defense increases by 1.
At Level 10, your Max Health increases by 5.
<Lich Ritual>.Name: <Lich Ritual>

~Phylactery~.Effect:
When you become a Lich, you place your soul inside a Phylactery - a special object, dear to you.
When you would reach 0 Health, instead of going Fallen, you can instantly teleport your body inside the Phylactery.
A spellcaster can channel when resting inbetween Adventures to resummon you near the Phylactery with full Health, Spells, etc.
If the Phylactery is destroyed, you must wait 1 year to make another one.
~Phylactery~.Name: ~Phylactery~

~Dismorphment~.Effect:
When a Unit declares an attack or Spell on you, you can instantly teleport up to 3 meters away.
That Unit can keep their action or change it.
You can also instantly teleport using 0 {A}Action Points on your turn.
~Dismorphment~.Notes: Remember that at Level 6, the range of this becomes 6 as per the description of Cleric Lich Ritual.
~Dismorphment~.Name: ~Dismorphment~

~Death Pact~.Effect:
Choose an ally (or yourself).
They lose 5 Health. You gain 1 {Mana}Mana this turn only.
~Death Pact~.Name: ~Death Pact~

<What Is A Spellbook>.Effect:
Your Level 2 Talents (_mancy_) and Font Spells no longer matter.
At the start of each Adventure and end of every Combat, roll 1d4. You instead know all Font Spells and _mancy_ that correspond to what you rolled, within your Level.
<What Is A Spellbook>.Name: <What Is A Spellbook>

<Faithful Scripture>.Requirement: Paladin. Only usable in Worthy combat.
<Faithful Scripture>.Effect:
Choose an Ability you can currently cast with Faith Casting to store for later.
You can use it once any time until the end of the Adventure, but you can't use it otherwise until the end of the Adventure.
<Faithful Scripture>.Name: <Faithful Scripture>

<Deity From Beyond>.Effect: Choose a different Basic Ability School which will have its Spell's ^Dice Upgraded^ to the next die type (and it will no longer be the Divine Ability School).
<Deity From Beyond>.Name: <Deity From Beyond>

~Experienced War Fierce~.Effect: Choose one more {Color('#ff5900' 'Fierce')} Craft! You can't apply the {Color('#ff5900' 'Fierce')} bonus Damage twice at the same time.
~Experienced War Fierce~.Name: ~Experienced War Fierce~

~Lucky Seven~.Effect: You automatically roll 7 on all d12's and every two d6's.
~Lucky Seven~.Name: ~Lucky Seven~
